paragraphs.text: Vegetable is an unreleased acorn species of animated parts of plants normally consumed as food .

Vegetable was a creature type that was designed for Unglued 2: The Obligatory Sequel before it was canceled. It was featured on numerous planned cards with the race being common in the setting of the set. Some of the featured vegetables included broccoli, celery, cucumber, green pepper, pickle, potato, and rutabaga. They were planned to be associated with poison .
